text.p: Grain and oilseed exports reported by USDA and private export sources.
SOYBEAN SALE - Argentina bought 60,000 tonnes of new crop U.S. soybeans for October/November delivery, Argentine traders said.
RICE SALE - The Japanese Food Agency said on Wednesday it bought 7,000 tonnes of foreign rice at its first import tender in the fiscal 1997/98 year ending March.
WHEAT SALE - Egypt bought 100,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter wheat for $170.00 per ton, C & F, for August to October delivery.

CORN TENDERS - Naseem Agriculture of Abu Dhabi is seeking a consignment of 10,000 or 15,000 tonnes of U.S., Argentine or South African yellow maize for shipment in the second half of August, South Africa's shippers association said. Bids were invited C and F Abu Dhabi by June 6.
- South Korea's Korea Feed Association passed on a tender to buy 52,500 tonnes of corn due to high offer prices, traders said Tuesday.
- CCC said it will offer 8.2 million bushels of corn for sale from its feedgrain catalog, with offers due June 3 and results announced June 4.

WHEAT TENDERS - Iraq was still negotiating the purchase of 50,000 tonnes of U.S. hard red winter for July shipment under a United Nations monitored oil-for-food pact, European grain traders said. The tender launched since last week has not yet led to any sales because exporters feel Iraq's offer of $194 per tonne, including cost and freight, is too low, they said. Exporters have placed initial offers to sell the wheat at around $210-212 per tonne.
- Pakistan seeks 376,000 tonnes of U.S. and/or Australian white wheat. Results were expected on May 29. Shipment is for June 11-July 10.
WHEAT TENDERS - South Korea's Cheiljedang Corp and Dongah Flour Mills Co Ltd have jointly invited tenders to buy 22,500 tonnes of U.S. No.1 wheat by 2:00 p.m. (0500 GMT) on Thursday, traders said.
- Sri Lanka seeks 50,000 to 60,000 tonnes of PL-480 wheat for June 30-July 19 shipment. Offers are due by 1930 GMT June 5 at the Sri Lankan embassy in Washington.
- CCC seeks 5,000 tonnes of U.S. HRW wheat on May 28 for donation to Benin. Shipment dates are June 15-July 10.
BARLEY TENDER - Turkey will sell the breakaway Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus 65,000 tonnes of feed barley to help the drought-hit island, officials said.
RICE TENDERS - Jordan has cancelled its 15,000-tonne tender for optional origin medium grain milled rice, U.S. exporters and trade sources said. Shipment had been slated for June.
RICE TENDER (Cont) - State-run Rice Export Corporation of Pakistan invited bids by May 26 for the export of 5,000 tonnes of basmati Pak-7 rice containing seven percent brokens.
- Syria's General Foreign Trade Organisation for Chemicals and Foostuffs seeks offers June 4 to buy 12,000 tonnes of white rice for July with confirmation on June 12.
